name: shopping-list-for-bring
author: samuel
description: Unofficial Pebble / Index 01 plugin that adds to Bring! shopping lists. Not affiliated with Bring! Labs AG.

usesPermissions.name: Internet
usesPermissions.reason: To add items to your Bring! lists and read what's on them

usesPermissions.name: Internet
usesPermissions.reason: To match item names with Bring!'s catalog, so items get their icon and section

plugin.description: The user's shopping list (Bring!, Einkaufsliste): add groceries and anything else to buy, check items off, read what is on it. Not for reminders or to-dos.

actions.name: add_items
actions.description: The user keeps their shopping list in Bring!. Use this, not create_list_item, for anything they want to buy (groceries, food, drinks, household or hardware supplies), including when they say "shopping list", "grocery list", "Einkaufsliste", "einkaufen" or "kaufen". Not for reminders or to-dos. One entry per product, named in the user's language; put amounts and details in specification ("2 l", "organic"), not in name. Omit list to use the default Bring! list.

items.description: The products to add, one entry per product.

specification.description: Optional amount or detail, e.g. "2 l" or "lactose-free".

list.description: Only when the user names one of their Bring! lists (e.g. "Party"): its name. Omit for the default list.

actions.name: complete_item
actions.description: Check an item off the user's Bring! shopping list (mark it as bought), e.g. when they say they bought or got it. Omit list to use the default Bring! list.

name.description: The item as the user said it, e.g. "milk".

list.description: Only when the user names one of their Bring! lists: its name. Omit for the default list.

instanceId.description: Item id from shopping/item, when checking off the item a watch tile shows.

actions.name: read_list
actions.description: Read what is on the user's Bring! shopping list (what they still need to buy), plus the names of their other Bring! lists.

list.description: Only when the user names one of their Bring! lists: its name. Omit for the default list.
